type: Computerized lockstitch machine with THREE stepping motors: backstitch, wire-cutting, and auxiliary wire-cutting
source: A5E-B-NX Control Box Operation Manual（三步进)电控使用说明书_V0.5_20260127.pdf (16 pages, English/Chinese bilingual)
note: The A5E-B-NX ('Three-Step') is a variant of the A5E-B with THREE stepper motors: (1) backstitch stepper (same as standard A5E-B/AMH2), (2) wire-cutting stepper motor (replaces trimming solenoid), and (3) auxiliary wire-cutting stepper motor (for bird's nest function). This results in additional error codes Err-32 to Err-38 (auxiliary cutter) and Err-51 to Err-57 (wire cutter), and additional parameters P366-P493 for bird's nest motion control. Sockets: ① Foot Pedal & Upgrade & Electronic Knee Rest Socket; ② Electromagnet, LED light, machine head button, and thickness sensor socket; ③ Suction Device & Bird's Nest Interface, Mop Wheel (Purchased).

buttons.name: Front Reinforcement Button
buttons.description: Each press cycles: Front Seam Fixing → Front Double Seam Fixing → Off. Selects stitch count for segments A and B.

buttons.name: Rear Reinforcement / Mode Switch Button
buttons.description: Back-locking: cycles back-locking → back double-locking → off. Sets stitch count for C and D. Mode switch: free stitch → W stitch → multi-segment stitch.

buttons.name: Up/Down Stop Needle Position / Thread Trim Button
buttons.description: 1. Short press: switch between up/down stop needle positions. 2. Long press: toggle automatic thread trimming function. 3. Press and hold P + thread cutting button: enter blade angle viewing interface (shows thread cutting stepper motor angle during thread cutting).

buttons.name: Pattern Sewing Button / Piecework Interface Button
buttons.description: 1. Short press to enter pattern sewing mode; short press again to switch between pattern sewing interface and settings. 2. Long press to enter/exit piecework mode.

buttons.name: Restore Factory Settings (Reset)
buttons.description: Long press to restore factory settings.

buttons.name: Presser Foot Lift Button
buttons.description: 1. Short press cycles: presser foot on → midway → on after thread trimming → midway off after trim → off after trim → off. 2. Long press: quickly adjust presser foot height (P173=midway height, P174=after cutting height).

buttons.name: Thickness/Thickness Button
buttons.description: 1. Short press: turn thickness detection function on/off. 2. Long press: enter thickness detection quick parameter adjustment interface.

buttons.name: Cable Clamping Button / Bird's Nest Removal Button
buttons.description: 1. Short press: toggle cable clamping function on/off. 2. On -N models: long press to toggle 'fewer bird nests' function on/off (cannot turn on when wire cutting is off). 3. Long press P + bird nest button: enter bird nest parameter shortcut interface.

buttons.name: Voice Button
buttons.description: 1. Short press: toggle voice function and startup message sequentially. 2. Long press when idle: enter multi-language switching interface. 3. Short press: play voice navigation when error occurs.

buttons.name: Call Button
buttons.description: When network connection successful: 1. Short press: equipment fault call (displays CALL, returns after 2s). 2. Long press: production assistance call (displays HELP, returns after 2s). 3. P + Call: call function off (displays OFF, returns after 2s).

userParams.access: Long press P key in idle mode → operator parameter mode → use Left/Right to move cursor → use +/- to modify → press P once to save; press P second time to exit.

technicianParams.access: Press and hold P key to power on → technician parameter mode (jumps to P44, all technician parameters open). Adjustment same as operator parameter mode.

monitoringMode.access: In idle mode, press P + Lifting Presser Foot key → monitoring mode → use +/- to adjust monitoring parameter items → press P to exit. For items 24, 25, 26, 28: long press P to save to corresponding parameter.
monitoringMode.specialMode: In M24 interface, long press wire cutter button to enter special mode — rotate handwheel to specific angle and wire cutter stepper motor will cut wire.

parameterEntry.upperNeedleStop: Enter monitoring item 24, adjust handwheel to upper stop needle position (parameter changes with handwheel), long press P to save (lower needle position automatically adjusted). Press P to exit.
parameterEntry.speedAdjust: In idle mode, press + or - to adjust speed; each press adjusts 50 RPM. Hold for continuous change.
parameterEntry.languageSwitch: Long press voice button; switch with +/- keys. 0=English; 1=Spanish; 2=Portuguese; 3=Russian; 4=Arabic; 5=Vietnamese; 6=Persian; 7=Bengali; 8=Turkish; 9=Indonesian; 10=Polish; 11=Italian; 12=Thai; 13=Ukrainian; 14=Chinese; 15=Korean (multi-lingual version).

thicknessCalibration.access: Long press P + Thickness button → zero-point calibration mode (thickness icon flashes, other icons turn off; left 3 digits show -A-, right 4 digits show calibrated voltage value)
steps: Long press P + Thickness key to enter zero-point calibration mode
Step on foot pedal forward — machine finds upper needle position
Calibration complete (plays voice, displays calibrated value) — short press P to exit

quickParamAdjust.access: Press and hold P + stitch length increase key → Quick Parameter Adjustment Mode. Short press +/- to switch options.

options.description: Sets stepper motor to position 0. Press pedal for no-thread sew; check if needle runs in one hole. Adjust to calibrate. Short press P to save.
Adjusts stitch length 4.0 forward (target 3.9-4.1mm). Press 10 times and measure. Short press P to save.
Adjusts backstitch stitch length 4.0 (first press 10+ forward stitches, then hold backstitch button; backstitch holes should overlap forward holes by 10+ stitches). Short press P to save.
Adjusts forward stitch length 5.0 (target 4.8-5.2mm). Press 10 times and measure. Short press P to save.
Adjusts backstitch stitch length 5.0 (requires 5+ stitches aligned; P145 should not exceed 630). Short press P to save.
Adjusts backstitch stitch length 3.0 (at least 5 stitches needed for overlap). Short press P to save.
Adjusts backstitch stitch length 2.0 (at least 5 stitches for overlap). Short press P to save.

Adjusts presser foot height. Use gauge block when stopping midway; increase value to increase height, decrease to decrease. Measure 1mm presser foot lifting height. Short press P to save; press P again to exit.

parameterEntry.bladeAngleViewing: Press and hold P + thread cutting button (button 9) → blade angle viewing interface → shows angle of thread cutting stepper motor during thread cutting.
parameterEntry.birdsNestShortcut: Press and hold P + bird nest button (button 14) → bird nest parameter shortcut interface.

errorCodes.solution: 1. Turn off system power, turn back on after 30 seconds. 2. Check spindle motor encoder and electrical control for damage. Replace if necessary. 3. Contact local service provider or call 4008876858.
Disconnect controller power, check if input supply voltage is lower than 176V. Restart after voltage returns to normal. Contact service provider if still fails.
Disconnect controller power, check if input voltage is higher than 264V. Restart after voltage returns to normal.

errorCodes.description: Spindle motor current detection circuit failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, back on after 30 seconds to observe normal work. Try several times. If fault occurs frequently, contact local service provider.

1. Check for foreign objects around machine head, stuck shuttle thread, stuck eccentric wheel. 2. Disconnect power and check spindle motor power input plug condition. 3. Contact service provider if still fails.
1. Check if connection between operation panel and electrical control is loose, disconnected, or broken. 2. Contact service provider if still fails after restart.

errorCodes.description: Spindle motor initial angle detection failure
errorCodes.solution: Please try again 2-3 times after powering off. Contact local service provider if fault persists.
1. Turn off system power, back on after 30 seconds. 2. Check spindle motor encoder and electrical control for damage. Replace if necessary. 3. Contact service provider.

troubleshooting.issue: Err-32 to Err-38 (auxiliary wire-cutting stepper motor errors)
troubleshooting.cause: Auxiliary wire-cutting stepper motor (bird's nest function motor) fault
troubleshooting.solution: Turn off system power, check the auxiliary wire-cutting stepper motor connector, and restart. These errors are specific to the three-step NX variant. Contact service provider if error persists.

troubleshooting.issue: Err-51 to Err-57 (wire-cutting stepper motor errors)
troubleshooting.cause: Wire-cutting stepper motor (replaces trimming solenoid) fault
troubleshooting.solution: Turn off system power, check the wire-cutting stepper motor connector, and restart. These errors are specific to the three-step NX variant. Contact service provider if error persists.

troubleshooting.cause: Operation panel hardware does not match the controller
troubleshooting.solution: Replace the operation panel with the correct NX-compatible panel type, then power on again to restore parameters.

Use M24 monitoring interface: long press wire cutter button to enter special mode; rotate handwheel to specific angle; wire cutter stepper motor will cut wire. Exit special mode by leaving M24 interface.
